key_impacts: Around 70,000 excess deaths reported in western Europe.
Record high temperatures led to markedly higher mortality, especially among the elderly.
evidence_snippets: The hot summer of 2003 in Europe produced sustained record high temperatures and markedly higher death rates, particularly among the elderly.
It has been estimated that 70,000 more deaths occurred in western Europe during that extreme summer.
